name: 덩기
silhouette: 마디가 나뉜 긴 지네 형태, 머리 부분의 튀어나온 두 개의 더듬이, 양옆으로 뻗은 짧은 다리들
signature_vfx: 이동 경로에 남는 밝은 연두색 잔상
visual_en: A small 28px centipede-like creature facing right. The head features two prominent bright neon green eyes and short antennae. The body is composed of several segments in dark teal and deep navy, with bright mint-colored lines separating each segment. Numerous small, thin legs protrude from the sides of the body segments. The tail end tapers into a sharp point. The entire silhouette is highlighted by the glowing neon green eyes and mint accents, making it visible against dark backgrounds.
pose_en: Darting sideways in a rapid zigzag pattern
vfx_en: A bright neon green motion trail following the zigzag path
lore: 아주 빠르고 늘 지그재그로 달린다. 드물게 나온다.
